The premise that God is "hidden" and therefore indistinguishable from non-existence rests on a deliberate epistemological blindness. Scripture directly refutes this assertion, establishing that the data of God's existence and sovereignty is neither silent nor absent—it is overwhelming, continuous, and universally accessible.

1. General Revelation: The Data Is Universal and Unceasing
Creation is not an empty vacuum; it constantly transmits forensic data declaring its Maker:

Psalm 19:1–3: "The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament shows His handiwork. Day unto day utters speech, and night unto night reveals knowledge. There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard."

Romans 1:19–20: Paul establishes the legal liability of the skeptic:
"Because what may be known of God is manifest in them, for God has shown it to them. For since the creation of the world His invisible attributes are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even His eternal power and Godhead, so that they are without excuse."

The Greek term for "without excuse" is ἀναπολογήτους (anapologētous)—literally lacking any legal defense in a court of law. The data is not missing; it is omnipresent.

2. The Mechanics of "Hiddenness": Suppression, Not Absence

The God of the Bible is not hidden due to lack of evidence; He is invisible to the rebel because fallen man actively suppresses the incoming data:
Suppressing the Truth in Unrighteousness (Romans 1:18): The Greek verb is κατεχόντων (katechontōn), meaning to intentionally hold down, repress, or stifle. The skeptic does not suffer from a data deficiency; they suffer from a moral hostility that refuses to acknowledge where the data leads.

Eyes That Do Not See (Matthew 13:13–15; Isaiah 6:9–10): Jesus explained why divine Truth appears obscured to the world: "Seeing they do not see, and hearing they do not hear, nor do they understand... For the hearts of this people have grown dull. Their ears are hard of hearing, and their eyes they have closed."

3. The Objective Data Points Dismissed by Skepticism

To claim there is "no data" requires ignoring the primary pillars of reality:

Cosmological & Teleological Data: The data of the cell's genetic code is undeniable. DNA functions as high-density, four-character digital software containing billions of precise instructions. Information science proves that functional code never generates itself from undirected material processes—it requires an Author. As Psalm 139:16 declares, our unformed substance was 'written in Your book' long before modern science discovered the digital nature of the human genome.

The Moral Data: The universal human recognition of objective right and wrong, justice, and culpability cannot exist in a purely materialistic universe where humans are merely accidental chemical reactions.
The Historical Data: The physical, historical Incarnation and Resurrection of Jesus Christ—attested by eyewitness testimony, legal scrutiny, and fulfilled prophetic timelines across centuries (Acts 26:26: "this thing was not done in a corner").

The claim that a "hidden god produces the same data as no god at all" is an indictment of the observer, not an absence of the Creator. A blind man standing in the midday sun receives the exact same visual data as if he were standing in a pitch-black room, yet the darkness resides entirely within his own damaged eyes, not in the sun. God has inscribed His signature across the cosmos, within the moral conscience, and through the documented reality of the risen Christ. The data is absolute; it is the rebellious heart of man that willfully closes its eyes, stops its ears, and renames its self-imposed blindness an intellectual virtue.

【2026WirForce 活動時間軸】
#2026WirForce 即將於下周四 9/24 開始舉辦!
我們再來更仔細地了解本次 #WirForce 有哪些活動吧!

需要注意的是，主舞台以及夜間 (18時過後)活動
僅BYOC和 96hr全通票才能參與 (以下標示為🎫)。

〔9/24 (四) 第一天〕
💠10:00–11:00｜主舞台🎫
第一天活動開始，「主舞台」會先有記者會 (10-11)。

💠15:30–17:30｜野台
第一天下午，「野台」在 1530-1730 有台北市電競體驗活動，
該活動由 J Team 舉辦，將會帶來《快打旋風 6》對戰體驗 。

💠19:00–21:00｜玩家舞台🎫
第一天晚上 19-21時，在玩家舞台有舉辦 首夜祭: 格鬥之夜，
這個場就是僅BYOC和 96hr全通票才能參與的部分。

〔9/25 (五) 第二天〕
💠12:00–14:00｜野台
第二天中午 12-14時，
於「野台」有舉辦日系偶像LIVE演出，
演出卡司包含 #存在証明 NO FACE NO REaLiTY 、
#RukaBanana 、 #天国地獄 、 #虹星iRiSTELLA
以及 i<3 ，如果喜歡這些地偶團體，
千萬要把這個時間記在行事曆當中啊!

💠13:00–14:20｜主舞台🎫
接著就是Holo迷需要筆記的時間了，
第二天下午 1300-1420，
於「主舞台」有舉辦 #HololiveMeet
#KoboKanaeru & #HakosBaelz 見面會，
但要注意，這個活動僅限BYOC和 96hr全通票才能參與，
另外，參加本次見面會者，
可於入場時領取「Hololive Meet特典明信片」一組兩款。

💠14:30–17:30｜野台
第二天下午 1430-1730，
於「野台」則是進行 WirForce Cosplay大賽決賽，
先前 WF官方已於網路上公布今年網路人氣獎得主「究極」，
接下來，就讓我們一起期待9/25下午決賽的冠軍吧!

AUM grows faster than costs, operating leverage kicks in and profits can scale disproportionately.

Isliye earnings thodi lumpy ho sakti hain, but successful exits ke time upside bhi kaafi powerful ho sakta hai.

Gaja Alternative Asset Management. 🧐

Q1FY27:

Total income: ₹51.8 Cr, +26%
PAT: ₹27.2 Cr, +35%

PAT margin is obviously huge.

But asset managers need to be understood differently.

Gaja earns from:

💰 Management/fee income
💰 Performance-linked economics
💰 Sponsor participation in its funds

Now SEBI has approved its ₹2,500 Cr Fund.

And the recent IPO raised ₹550 Cr, including ₹450 Cr of fresh capital.

This creates an interesting flywheel:

Raise larger funds
→ AUM grows
→ recurring fees grow
→ successful exits create performance income
→ stronger track record helps raise the NEXT fund.

Beautiful when it works. 🔥

But don't annualise one quarter's PAT blindly.

Performance income can be lumpy.
By nature AMCs and other market linked businesses do well during market up-cycle only !!

For me the key metric isn't just PAT growth.

It's how the FEE-EARNING CAPITAL compounds over multiple fund vintages.

I have watched two birds
leave the same branch
in opposite directions,
each carrying a little morning
inside its wings.
The branch did not follow.
It simply trembled awhile
beneath the weight
of what had been there.

Love comes like that..
without asking whether the season is kind,
without consulting distance or tomorrow.
It places its whole, unreasonable tenderness
into our ordinary hands
and calls that faith.
For a while, someone becomes the lamp
left burning in the kitchen
after every other room has gone dark,
and even loneliness forgets its old name.

Then the weather changes.
Not cruelly.
Only as weather does.
A road bends where neither heart expected.
A season asks more
than two people can give
and still remain gentle.
And suddenly you are learning
how to become separate
without becoming strangers.

Yet the body keeps its small knowledge:
how they liked the window open,
how much milk went into their coffee,
which silence meant stay,
the almost invisible tiredness
that entered their voice before sleep.
Morning comes,
and all that knowing wanders the rooms
like a dog no one has told
the door will not open again.

I used to call this failure.
I was wrong.
Some loves come as rain
to a field that has forgotten rain..
brief, 
complete,
already disappearing into the earth
while the roots beneath
are only beginning to wake.
The rain does not remain
to witness what it has changed.

Years later, 
something greens.
Perhaps only a tenderness
you cannot remember learning,
the way you now hold another person's sorrow
without trying to repair it,
the mercy with which you forgive
what once would have hardened you.
And somewhere beneath your ribs
there is still a small room
where winter enters
but cannot finish its work.

So if love finds you
in tall grass,
at an airport,
across an impossible distance,
or barefoot in an ordinary kitchen,
go toward it.
Do not ask the sky
to swear it will never change.
The sky has other work.
Love does not become more true
because it survives every season.

And if one day you must open your hand
around the one
you once believed you would keep,
open it gently..
as you would release a living bird
back into the enormous field.
Not because holding it meant nothing.
Not because leaving makes the love less real.
But because sometimes the last tenderness
we can give what we love
is not to turn our love into a cage.

Then let them go.

The hand will remember the warmth.
The branch will remember the weight.
The field will remember the rain.

Someone walks away.
The longing does not.

It stays
the way evening light stays trembling on water
after the bird
has disappeared beyond the trees..

not asking to be called forever,
not asking to be understood,

only shining
where something beautiful
once passed.
